title: Hardened Moon Rod

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Use to craft the Celestial Hammer, Heavenly Pollaxe, Lunar Staff, Astral Saw, Crater Chisel, Eclipse Crossbow, and Starlight Sickle.

body:
The hardened Moon Rod is a rod obtained in the The Monstrous Manor on top of the hill near The Oak Depot. It can be purchased for 10,250 Candy. The Hardened Moon Rod is located on the second floor, on the lap of one of the mannequins at the couch and chairs. It can be used to craft the 3 Tools from the 2024 halloween event and the 7 tools from the 2025 Halloween event
